description:
Bungaku wo Musaboru Monotachi
Due to lack of staff, the Literature Club will be disbanded. At least three students must be recruited by the deadline to avoid disbandment.
The Literature Club's president, Shiori Sakura, approached three students who were in the club room who had mistaken it for an empty room and saved the club from being disbanded. At first, they teased her with obscene talk and H-books. Then it escalated... The sexual harassment became direct and one of them raped her. Then the other two came in and instead of helping her, they joined in, and in the end, the three of them took turns to rape her. They took pictures and videos of her, and she was unable to resist. From that point on, under the name of the Literature Club, the three treated her like a flesh-eating toilet.
A freshman, Makoto Niijima, has recently joined the club, but he does not yet know what it is really like.
